concept.CONCEPT_NAME: Secondary chronic nephritis

InclusionRules.name: no Secondary chronic nephritis (secondary form), on or before index
InclusionRules.description: Structural rule-out, secondary/induced form of the anchor: vocab: sibling of Chronic kidney disease under Renal impairment, Chronic disease of genitourinary system, named as a secondary/induced form. TRADE-OFF: raises specificity by removing anyone coded Secondary chronic nephritis on or before index. Expected cost unknown (source lacks co-occurrence counts). Keep for 'clean' cases; drop, or lump the mimic into S1, if the two can legitimately coexist and the study wants every case.

InclusionRules.name: has >=1 Chronic kidney disease dx within 0..+365d of index (route confirmer)
InclusionRules.description: Route confirmer: people who entered on a drug or lab (S2) must also carry the diagnosis within 365 days; people who entered on the diagnosis satisfy it at index. Window from temporal_policy (chronic), not from any KG edge.
